bio: Bass De Medici, a distinguished member of the Cittadini class, represents a branch of the famed Florentine banking family that established roots in Venice a generation ago, bringing their financial acumen to the maritime republic. Though not of patrician blood, Bass has leveraged his family connections and personal ambition to secure a respectable position within Venetian society. His recent elevation to Cittadini status reflects his growing influence in commercial affairs and his contributions
